items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And Jack Washington. ... Jack Washington was there. ... So then we played with three trumpets, one trombone, that's four, two reeds, that's six and Page, Jo and Basie that's nine. That's the way it was when I came there.

ctx.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?
